items.text: This patch fixes many problems that you reported to us and also improves overall stability and performance of the game.
We know that you have recently reported bugs that you have encountered in the game - we are looking into each of them separately to better look at what could have caused the problem during the game.
We would like to thank you for your involvement and feedback, as well as apologize for encountering bugs during the game.

A new, revolutionary tool is available with this update, which will make your work in the scrapyard much easier. Thanks to the powerful magnet mounted on the crane, you will be able to quickly lift and sort heavy elements, which will speed up the entire demolition process.

This new and innovative solution will allow you to manage materials more effectively, increasing the productivity and efficiency of your work. With the magnet on the crane, ship demolition will become much easier and less time-consuming, allowing you to better use your time and resources.
We are continuously working to support and improve the game, so if you encounter any issues, don't hesitate to reach out us on Steam or Discord.

items.text: New stuff! We've introduced functionality to add some flair & personality to your scrapyard house. You can now expand it with new rooms, decorate it and paint however you'd like! We've also expanded the beach, adding another big area to run & drive around, prepared for some very big ships... Whenever they arrive. We've also implemented changes to the crate weight limit, so now the highest upgrade level can fit even more stuff!

First game launch after patch might take a minute or two along with ~5fps showing, but do not worry - it's the engine generating metafiles for better optimization. After the first launch, every consecutive launch will be much, much much faster. Same with game saves.
If you are experiencing crashes on the loading screen, please change the DirectX version in Steam's game settings.

releases.displayName: Update on the release date of Playtest CO-OP Mode

items.text: Last week we promised that the Playtest of CO-OP Mode would be available this week, but unfortunately, with great heartache, we have to inform you about the change of the Playtest release date.

Currently, the entire team is involved in bug fixes for Warships DLC, which really surprised us. As a small development team, we want to first improve the stability of the Warships DLC and then fully focus on the Playtest of CO-OP Mode so that you can fully enjoy smashing ships with hammers with your friends, that's why we need a few more days.
Therefore, we decided to change the Playtest release date. We want to be absolutely sure that you - our community - who support our game by purchasing DLC, could enjoy the game without any problems.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to make sure you can fully experience this next milestone with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2. We assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.
We will get back to you with further information - thank you. 🤝
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team

items.text: Check it out and break out a brand new ship, try out mobile cargo and more! 💥
New small ship with all new contracts - Slippery Herring
Crane upgrades - players are able to purchase crane upgrades to speed it up
Crane queue - players are able to choose more than one heavy element and queue them
Crouching - new player ability to crouch. Please note that those who own the game and use their own settings must choose the crouching input manually in the settings.
New wiki entries

Mobile cargo - mobile cargo is handy while picking many crates at the same time and throw them inside. Once full, crane picks them all up and stores in the warehouse. Players are able to purchase the cargo in the forge (same as explosives), place it on the level using walkie talkie tool and RMB. Few mobile cargos have been hidden on the ships already.
Sorting place improvements - players can choose auto-sorting option to skip the mini game using 10% of the resources as a fee.
Additionally, the mini game can be paused while sorting.
Collectibles - there're collectibles to find on all the ships. Once the collectible has been found it'll be stored in the house. They're also full of fun facts.
Celebrations - new "celebrating" animations once the tool upgrade is purchased.
